title: Build an HTML project-docs status report
description: Scans the workspace for project-docs/ artifacts (same data as project-docs-lineage) and writes a single, self-contained HTML report with a lineage graph and status summary. Not committed. Run with --dry-run to preview without writing.

project.description: Scope the report to one project's own artifacts (plus their direct ancestors, shown as context) instead of the whole workspace. Violations are always computed workspace-wide first, so scoping never misclassifies a cross-project reference.

outputPath.description: Where to write the report. Defaults to project-docs/report.html under the workspace root, or under the scoped project's own root when --project is given.

noSynthesis.description: Skip the claude/gh-copilot synthesis cascade entirely and always use the deterministic, computed summary — for CI or anyone who wants reproducible, LLM-independent report diffs.
